prompt: The Splice project {project} holds a silent 36-second screen recording (no voice) of someone working in TextEdit: three short bursts of clicking and typing separated by long idle stretches. Make it a 15 to 25 second vertical short: 9:16 with a background frame around the window, the idle time cut but every click and keystroke kept, a bigger cursor with click rings, zooms where they click, and clean transitions. Check your work, then export with the social preset. Use the splice MCP tools only.

checks.name: 15-25 s
checks.expr: 15 <= sum(c['length'] for c in clips) / project['fps'] <= 25

checks.name: every action kept
checks.expr: all(any(c['source'] <= a * project['fps'] < c['source'] + c['length'] * c['speed'] for c in take_clips()) for a in [2.0, 4.0, 14.0, 16.0, 27.0, 29.0])

checks.name: idle cut
checks.expr: sum(c['length'] for c in take_clips()) < 30 * project['fps']

checks.name: background frame
checks.expr: (effect('window') or {}).get('background', 'gradient') != 'none' and effect('window') is not None
